result.topic_en: Euler lists the differentials of the partial derivatives p, q, r etc. with respect to the variation parameter t, substitutes them into dV to obtain the variation formula (dV/dt) for expressions of the second kind, and announces the treatment of expressions of the third kind involving integral formulas.
result.transcription:
48 METHODVS NOVA CALCVLVM
cum ſuis transformationibus per ſe ſatis claris ita ſe habebunt:
$dp = dt\left(\frac{dp}{dt}\right) = dt\left(\frac{ddz}{dx\,dt}\right)$; $dp' = dt\left(\frac{dp'}{dt}\right) = \left(\frac{ddz}{dy\,dt}\right)$
$dq = dt\left(\frac{dq}{dt}\right) = dt\left(\frac{d^3z}{dx^2\,dt}\right)$; $dq' = dt\left(\frac{dq'}{dt}\right) = dt\left(\frac{d^3z}{dx\,dy\,dt}\right)$;
$dq'' = dt\left(\frac{dq''}{dt}\right) = dt\left(\frac{d^3z}{dy^2\,dt}\right)$
$dr = dt\left(\frac{dr}{dt}\right) = dt\left(\frac{d^4z}{dx^3\,dt}\right)$; $dr' = dt\left(\frac{dr'}{dt}\right) = dt\left(\frac{d^4z}{dx^2\,dy\,dt}\right)$
$dr'' = dt\left(\frac{dr''}{dt}\right) = dt\left(\frac{d^4z}{dx\,dy^2\,dt}\right)$; $dr''' = dt\left(\frac{dr'''}{dt}\right)$
$= dt\left(\frac{d^4z}{dy^3\,dt}\right)$ etc.

23. Totum ergo negotium huc redit, vt in formula illa differentiali pro $d$V data loco ſingulorum differentialium iſti valores ſubſtituantur, hocque modo prodibit variatio expreſſionis V ex ſola variabilitate ipſius $t$ oriunda, ſeu valor huius formulae $dt\left(\frac{dV}{dt}\right)$, quoniam autem ſingula membra elemento $dt$ erunt affecta, eo omiſſo adipiſcimur ſequentem formam:
$\left(\frac{dV}{dt}\right) = N\left(\frac{dz}{dt}\right) + P\left(\frac{ddz}{dx\,dt}\right) + Q\left(\frac{d^3z}{dx^2.\,dt}\right) + R\left(\frac{d^4z}{dx^3.\,dt}\right)$
$+ P'\left(\frac{ddz}{dy\,dt}\right) + Q'\left(\frac{d^3z}{dx\,dy\,dt}\right) + R'\left(\frac{d^4z}{dx^2\,dy\,dt}\right)$
$+ Q''\left(\frac{d^3z}{dy^2.\,dt}\right) + R''\left(\frac{d^4z}{dx\,dy^2\,dt}\right)$
$+ R'''\left(\frac{d^4z}{dy^3.\,dt}\right)$
quae ad variationes quarumcunque expreſſionum ſecundi generis inueniendas ſufficit.

24. Nunc expreſſiones tertii generis adgredi poterimus formulas integrales inuoluentes in quibus potiſſi-

items.quote: quae ad variationes quarumcunque expreſſionum ſecundi generis inueniendas ſufficit.
items.english: which suffices for finding the variations of any expressions whatever of the second kind.

items.quote: Nunc expreſſiones tertii generis adgredi poterimus formulas integrales inuoluentes
